def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Grid lines are the rows/columns containing many non-background cells.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h)
                 if sum(x != bg for x in grid[r]) > 0.4 * w]
    if not row_lines:
        return grid

    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in row_lines) > 0.4 * len(row_lines)]
    if not col_lines:
        return grid

    crossings = [grid[r][c] for r in row_lines for c in col_lines]
    base = Counter(crossings).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Keep only grid lines that participate in a colored crossing.
    marked = lambda v: v != bg and v != base
    rows = [r for r in row_lines if any(marked(grid[r][c]) for c in col_lines)]
    cols = [c for c in col_lines if any(marked(grid[r][c]) for r in row_lines)]

    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[bg]]

    out = [[bg for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]
            if corners[0] != bg and corners[0] != base and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    divider = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != background)

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(divider) > w // 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h)) > h // 2]

    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [[background]]

    special = lambda v: v != background and v != divider
    active_rows = [r for r in row_lines if any(special(grid[r][c]) for c in col_lines)]
    active_cols = [c for c in col_lines if any(special(grid[r][c]) for r in row_lines)]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return [[background]]

    r0, r1 = row_lines.index(active_rows[0]), row_lines.index(active_rows[-1])
    c0, c1 = col_lines.index(active_cols[0]), col_lines.index(active_cols[-1])
    rows = row_lines[r0:r1 + 1]
    cols = col_lines[c0:c1 + 1]

    out = [[background for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            vals = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                    grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            if vals[0] != background and vals[0] != divider and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
                out[i][j] = vals[0]
    return out
